description: This file contains unit tests for the tenantClient utility module, testing functions such as normalizeTenantId, fetchSessionTenants, selectTenant, and setActiveTenant using the Jest testing framework.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant ID representations to a string or null.

methods.description: Selects a tenant by ID, updates local storage, and notifies the server.

methods.description: Sets the active tenant ID in local storage, removing any legacy key.
